Sasami: "I see..."
*Sasami looked to the field of pink blossoms above.*
Sasami: "It was a long story, ehh... The story of Shining Song Starnova..."
Sasami: "At times there were dark moments... At times, everyone really looked like they were villains, didn't they?"
Sasami: "At times, it looked like the best path was to not have tried at all. To have given up and run away. To wish we had never been born at all..."
Sasami: "We thought that if we became idols, everyone around us would be happy... That our days would be filled with inspiration, joy, and motivation..."
Sasami: "Eh-heh... But that wasn't quite the case..."
Mr. Producer: "Sasa-chan?"
*Sasami ran ahead of me and leaned down as she looked back at the path we had traveled together.*
*A radiant smile was on her face.*
*More radiant than when she was before fifty thousand fans on the stage of our Dome Live.*
*This time, that smile was directed at just one fan. Me.*
Sasami: "But you know?"
Sasami: "I'm happy."
Sasami: "I think... I'm happy with everything that's happened so far!"
*I chuckled and smiled back to her.*
Mr. Producer: "I see."
*Despite everything, she looked back on her life with joy.*
*With just that single statement, I understood everything.*
*Sasami had no regrets.*
*Everything had led to this moment. This moment of bliss.*
*I walked up to her and took her arm.*
Mr. Producer: "Then, let's go."
Sasami: "Okay!"
*We walked side by side, surrounded by the falling pink petals, into the shining light of the future...*
